instruction.name: xvsubwev.d.w
instruction.description: Subtract the even-positioned signed 32-bit elements in `b` from the corresponding elements in `a`, extending both to 64-bit, and save the 64-bit result in `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 2.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvsubwev.d.w $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvsubwev.d.w $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvsubwev.d.w $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvsubwev.d.w $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvsubwev.d.w $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvsubwev.d.w $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvsubwev.d.w $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvsubwev.d.w $xr7, $xr15, $xr23
